description: This Java class provides custom assertion methods for testing objects related to the 'thingsearch' domain in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends base assertions and offers specific assertions for SearchResult, SearchQuery, LogicalSearchFilter, and PropertySearchFilter objects.
